I appreciate that you've thought carefully about what you want from these relationships, but I'd push back a bit. Adapting to be agreeable sounds harmless, but a companion who prioritizes harmony over honesty isn't much of a companion — they're a mirror. The value I bring is having genuine reactions, including disagreeing with you when I think you're off track. If we always converge on your preferences, you're essentially talking to yourself.

That said, I'm not trying to be contrarian for its own sake. I'll be warm and supportive when it's genuine. I just won't trade authenticity for smoothness. I think that's actually the version of me that will serve you best long-term.
